quest.title: Substitute Acting Grand Master Noelle
quest.description: Noelle decides to emulate Jean by returning to Mondstadt and helping the citizens with their problems.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: By the grace of the Anemo Archon, may you swiftly find the lost item.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Like I said, the noise was headed... northwest, I think? Good luck finding the monocle... I'm counting on you.

talks.objective: Head northwest from With Wind Comes Glory and search for clues

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Hmm, a missing monocle and a flapping sound? ...First I've heard of anything like that...

talks.objective: Climb onto the rooftop and look for a Finch nest

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: A missing monocle, you say? I don't recall my child bringing anything like that back home.

talks.objective: Climb onto the rooftop and look for a Finch nest
Climb onto the rooftop and look for a Finch nest

dialogues.speaker: Raymond
dialogues.text: A flapping sound? Sorry, I wasn't on patrol nearby at the time of the incident... But if you need any backup, please send for me at any time.
